dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave spline with a notable irregular indentation/notch located at the posterior basal junction.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute angularity with a minimal-radius rounded vertex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-degree posterior inclination relative to the primary longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Measured vertical height is approximately 1.4 times the basal width.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth, medium-radius convex curve extending from the blowhole region to the rostrum junction.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, tapered beak projection, significantly foreshortened due to the anterior-oblique orientation of the subject.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Shallow, obtuse angle at the pixel junction where the melon convexity meets the rostrum dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct V-shaped notch on the lower trailing edge of the dorsal fin; small, irregular white lesion or depigmented patch located on the dorsal-lateral surface posterior to the fin base.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent bi-tonal lateral pigmentation pattern consisting of a broad, high-value (light gray/white) sweeping band extending diagonally across the mid-body flank.
